setSelect.title: Choose your set
setSelect.lead: Pick the expansion to organize. Binderbound will work out the exact slot of every card in your binder.
setSelect.empty: No set available. Add a file to server/data/sets.

binder.title: Your binder
binder.lead: Tell us your page format and how it works.
binder.formatHint: Number of pockets on each face
binder.doubleSidedHint: Each sheet holds cards on both faces
binder.swipeHint: Swipe left or right to turn the pages
binder.sheetsHint_one: To hold the {{cards}} cards in this format ({{count}} side). A sheet = one plastic sleeve page, front and back.
binder.sheetsHint_other: To hold the {{cards}} cards in this format ({{count}} sides). A sheet = one plastic sleeve page, front and back.

options.title: Sorting options
options.lead: Choose the card order and where variants go.
options.breakByHint: Leaves empty slots so each group starts at the top of a face
options.breakByDisabledHint: Available when sorting by domain, rarity or type
options.reservedFacesHint: Faces left empty at the start (title page…)
options.startOnRightHint: Skips one face if the first card would land on a left-hand page
options.startOnRightSingle: Not needed single-sided: every face is on the right
options.startSummary: Front pages and starting on a right-hand page

after-base.label: After the base card
after-base.hint: Alt-arts follow their card; overnumbered and signatures keep their own number, at the end of the set

end.label: At the end of the set
end.hint: All variants grouped after the set

result.title: Your layout
result.lead: Here is the exact slot of every card. Search for a card to find it.

collection.title: My collection
collection.hint: Click a card to mark it as owned. Missing cards keep their slot.
collection.hintSynced: Click a card to mark it as owned. Your collection is synced with your account.

footer.disclaimer: Binderbound was created under Riot Games’ “Legal Jibber Jabber” policy using assets owned by Riot Games. Riot Games does not endorse or sponsor this project. Riftbound and League of Legends are trademarks of Riot Games, Inc.

auth.lead: Find your binders and collection on all your devices.
auth.name: Username
auth.guestNote: Don’t want an account? Everything else works without one: your collection stays in this browser, and joins your account if you create one later.

error.EMAIL_TAKEN: An account already exists with this email. Sign in instead.
error.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
error.GOOGLE_INVALID: Google sign-in failed. Please try again.
error.GOOGLE_NO_EMAIL: This Google account doesn’t share an email address.
error.default: Unable to sign in right now. Please try again.

invalid.name: Enter a username (80 characters max).
invalid.password: The password must be at least 8 characters.

binders.title: My binders
binders.lead: Your saved layouts, with your collection progress. Open one to view or edit it.
binders.empty: Pick a set, set up your binder, then click “Save” on the result.

save.title: Save binder
save.hint: Your settings will be saved to your account. Find them in “My binders”.
save.name: Binder name
save.limit: You’ve reached the maximum number of binders. Delete one first.
